firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: the signature shows (tabbed vellum sheet 01 IDEA, register marks, violet transfer line under the h1), there is one primary action plus a quieter secondary, the proof line reads 'Closed, opens tomorrow noon, 4.9 from 212 SAMPLE RATING', and the next band peeks about 50px. But the h1 'Drawn for you.' names no trade and no place; trade and city are only in the small eyebrow (-0.5). The phone number is never shown, only an icon button, at both sizes (-0.5). The right-hand plate is an SVG line forearm, not the healed-forearm photo the concept promised, so a stranger sees a stationery card. 390-first.jpg: h1 1 line and both buttons above the fold, but the forearm plate behind the sheet shows as a faint ghost with a stray register mark at the bottom right (reads as a rendering glitch).

distinctiveness.notes: Sheet stack + register mark shows in the hero, services, process, reviews, form and footer (1440-full.jpg, 1440-rm-full.jpg). The palette and type are unmistakably different from sibling B's dark mono session sheet (B/1440-first.jpg). It loses points because outside the process story the sheets are decoration: the services grid (1440-full.jpg, Styles band) and the review slips are standard cards with offset edges drawn behind them (-0.5). Hygiene, timeline and deposit (1440-scroll-75.jpg) drop the system entirely. Two 'heading left, side note right' intros are used 5 times (Styles, Process, Reviews, Day 1-42, Estimator).

type.notes: Instrument Serif + Hanken is a good, unique pair; display tracking is tight, quotes are curly, and the italic violet transfer word does have a job. Deductions: hyphen ranges 'noon - 8 pm' in both hour tables (1440-full.jpg contact + footer, -0.5); many tiny tracked caps labels in one view: rail 'S · STYLES', the S1-S8 tabs and 8x 'BOOK THIS' (1440-full.jpg Styles band, -0.5). There is no scale-contrast moment beyond the h1.

layout.notes: The tone rhythm works (paper/mid/paper/deep/photo break/mid/paper/deep/violet/paper/deep, 1440-full.jpg) and the full-bleed healed-photo break lands (1440-scroll-50.jpg). Deductions: the Day 1-42 band carries both the healing timeline and the deposit ledger, which is two jobs (1440-scroll-75.jpg, -0.5). The deposit box stops at about 1035px and leaves the right ~400px empty; the reviews right column ends 150px early, leaving a blank tail (1440-full.jpg, -0.5). The process story runs about 2.5 screens of mostly empty sheets (1440-scroll-25.jpg: sheet 02 is 500px tall for 3 lines).

photo.notes: The page has one photograph (1440-scroll-50.jpg, healed luna moth). It is on-topic and well chosen (healed, not fresh), and the caption is honest. The hero has no photo, though the concept's hero is a 'framed healed forearm photo plate' (1440-first.jpg, 390-first.jpg). For a tattoo buyer, healed work is the main trust signal (brief §1), so one frame is thin. The single frame is a warm phone snapshot with a soft-focus background and a red sleeve that fights the violet palette. No grade or treatment ties it to the vellum system (-0.5).

copy.notes: Strong trade voice ('Bring the screenshot', 'Flaking starts. Itchy is normal; picking isn't.', 'Nobody got rushed.'), and Sample labels sit on the rating, reviews, pricing and terms (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Deductions: the deposit ledger hands off to 'Book my six-week check', which does not match the block it ends (1440-scroll-75.jpg, -0.5). The Styles h2 promises 'one we say no to', but the refusal is only hinted at in grey side text; the 'no' is never named as an item (1440-full.jpg). Studio hours are printed twice, in the contact block and in the footer (1440-full.jpg).

mobile.notes: No overflow at 320/390 (render.json). The CTA bar is sticky and the buttons are full width (390-first.jpg). Deductions: 8 full-width service sheets run about 2,400px of one-per-row scroll (390-full.jpg Styles band; this is a desktop grid collapsed, not composed, -0.5). The timeline text sits flush against the vertical rail with 0 padding ('DAY 1' touches the line, 390-full.jpg Day 1-42). In the hero, the ghosted forearm plate and a stray register mark sit behind the sheet (390-first.jpg).

a11y.notes: render.json has no errors or console errors. 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word, and the process becomes a 5-up grid with every drawing state, as the concept promised. Headings run in order (h1, then h2 per band, h3 inside). Inputs have visible labels (1440-full.jpg form). Focus styling cannot be verified from the shots. The struck-through DAY labels (1440-scroll-75.jpg) are logged under polish.

motion.notes: The process drawing really is redrawn between sheets: scribble at 01 (1440-full.jpg) becomes a clean graphite line at 02 (1440-scroll-25.jpg) with a sticky plate beside the stacking sheets, so the motion explains the process. The intro transfer line draws under the h1, and the timeline line draws. Hooks beyond reveal: split, estimator, steps, open-now, zip, mobilebar. But the remaining bands (services, reviews, hygiene) appear to share one reveal-stagger (data-reveal / data-reveal-stagger), and the services sheet hover is the standard lift.

wow.notes: The process redraw (1440-scroll-25.jpg; 5 states in 1440-rm-full.jpg) is tied to the thesis and the trade. The estimator draws a violet stencil on a limb outline with a sittings answer and sample price (1440-full.jpg, 'Get a number before the consult'). It is not yet the 10: the estimator output sheet is small, sits beside the inputs and is not printable-looking, and the process sheets are mostly empty paper, so the moment reads quieter than it is.

polish.notes: SVG favicon, apple-touch icon, OG 1200x630, JSON-LD and a print stylesheet are all in dist/index.html. Defect: the timeline rule runs straight through the DAY 1-30 labels, so they read as struck-through text (1440-scroll-75.jpg; mustFix). The footer sheet is a designed close (1440-full.jpg footer). Drop shadows sit on every non-floating card (services, reviews, form) (-0.5).

mustFix.problem: The violet timeline rule sits on the baseline of the DAY 1/3/7/14/30 labels and strikes them through. Day 42 is clean, so this is a positioning bug.
mustFix.fix: Move the rule to the dot row (the line should pass through the centre of the 12px circles, about 34px above the labels) or give the labels padding-top so they sit at least 12px below the rule. Check at 1440 and 1024.

elevate.move: Make the healed photo the thing the sheets are laid over. Put a healed-work photo plate in the hero under sheet 01, as the concept promised, with register marks pinned to the photo's corners. Have the process story end at sheet 05 by lifting the last vellum sheet off a real healed photo, so the drawn sprig and the skin meet. Give every photo one shared treatment (a vellum-white frame plus a graphite-cool grade) so the photos read as one shoot, and add a second and third healed frame where they carry proof (reviews band, services).

Rewrite the hero so a stranger gets tattoo + Brooklyn + outcome in the display line ('Fine line tattoos, drawn for you in Brooklyn' set with the italic transfer on 'drawn for you'). Show the phone number as text in the header at 1440. Replace the lone SVG limb with the photo plate described above, so the first screen proves healed work instead of describing it.
